top_signals.title: Russian Strikes Leave Ukraine Farmers With Piles of Unsold Grain
top_signals.summary: More than four years ago, Ravil Dzhamally fled his farm in Ukraine’s Kherson region after it was overrun by invading Russian troops. When Moscow’s forces were driven back, he returned to clear his fields of mines and plant wheat, barley and sunflowers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Indian Bonds Drop as RBI Policy Minutes Spur Tightening Fears
top_signals.summary: Indian bonds fell as the minutes of the central bank’s latest policy meeting stoked fears of interest rates being raised sooner than expected as policymakers emphasized inflation risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
